meta.title: Figure Coaching
meta.description: Figure Coaching helps adults find clearer direction, calm confidence, and momentum through coaching inspired by Gestalt psychology, figure skating, and visualization.

hero.title: Find your own figure in coaching.
hero.description: I invite you to discover a clearer direction, a deeper sense of meaning, and a feeling of ease as you figure out your next step.
hero.ctaNote: The booking page opens in a new tab.
hero.visualCaption: Inspired by Gestalt, figure skating, curiosity, and visualization.

credo.label: Credo
credo.title: What I believe, and why it matters.
credo.intro: Coaching helps you notice what's already there, and makes it easier to move forward clearly, authentically, and with confidence.

form.title: Form and context
form.body: Drawing on Gestalt psychology, I value the relationship between figure and ground — what stands out, and what supports it.

skating.title: Skating practice
skating.body: Figure skating teaches patience, repetition, and grace under pressure — the same qualities that support growth in coaching.

figuring.title: Figuring it out
figuring.body: Coaching helps you make sense of uncertainty, and turn it into forward motion.

vision.title: Visualization
vision.body: I believe in forming a clear picture of what feels possible, then breaking it into manageable, meaningful steps.

roots.label: Values
roots.title: What keeps me rooted, even in a storm.
roots.intro: Three things I keep coming back to — with every client, on the ice, and in how I show up.

safe.title: Safe, accepting space
safe.body: You can bring exactly what's true for you, without needing to perform or filter it first.

trust.title: Trust and respect towards the process
trust.body: Growth isn't linear. I trust the process to unfold at its own pace, and respect wherever you are in it.

together.title: With you, not against
together.body: I'm not here to fix or push you. I'm on your side, working alongside you toward what you want.

me.label: About me
me.title: Hi — I'm your coach.
me.paragraph1: I'm an amateur adult competitive figure skater and figure skating coach. I bring that experience into coaching, and I keep looking for the approach that works for you until my message truly lands.
me.paragraph2: My goal is to help you see clearly, understand, and equip yourself to move forward with less resistance and more ease.

about.label: About coaching
about.title: When coaching can be the right fit.
about.intro: Coaching helps when you want to:

list.item1: clarify your next step or direction
list.item3: practice new ways of responding to stress or change
list.item4: create harmony between your goals and your everyday life

about.paragraph: Together we can map out your strengths, form a clearer picture of what matters, and design practical habits that actually last.

guidance.title: Attentive guidance
guidance.body: A coaching conversation that helps you feel seen and supported as you work things out.

practice.title: Practical work
practice.body: Small, realistic next steps that build momentum and move you forward.

clarity.title: Visual clarity
clarity.body: A clearer picture of what success looks like for you, with room to adjust as you grow.

footer.tagline: Figure Coaching — calm, grounded, and experiential support.
